item.title: Man convicted of attempted murder in shooting of three Palestinian students in Vermont
item.description: A man was convicted by a jury of attempted murder in the late 2023 shooting of three Palestinian American students in Vermont, two of whom were wounded and one was left paralyzed from the waist down, prosecutors said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: A man was convicted by a jury of [USN:L1N3CS1KP TEXT:"attempted murder"] in the [USN:L1N3CR0D6 TEXT:"late 2023 shooting"] of [USN:L1N3CY0AG TEXT:"three Palestinian American students"] in Vermont, two of whom were wounded and one was left paralyzed from the waist down, prosecutors said on Monday. Jason Eaton was found guilty on three counts of attempted second-degree murder for the shootings of Hisham Awartani, Tahseen Aliahmad and Kinnan Abdalhamid on November 25, 2023, in Burlington, Vermont, prosecutor Sarah George, the Chittenden County state's attorney, said in a statement. The conviction rejected Eaton's insanity defense and he will be sentenced at a later time, George said. A jury trial commenced in the Chittenden Superior Court a week ago and lasted till Monday. Eaton faces a sentence of up to life without parole, with a presumptive minimum term of 20 years to serve on each count, George said. The three Palestinian American students, who grew up in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, were walking in Burlington when Eaton approached and shot them, prosecutors and police said. Awartani was paralyzed from the chest down and now lives with paraplegia, his family said. Aliahmad was struck in the chest and Abdalhamid was struck in the glute while running away, according to prosecutors. Aliahmad and Abdalhamid were visiting Awartani's grandmother over a Thanksgiving break from school. All three were 20 at the time and wore black-and-white Palestinian keffiyeh scarves while conversing in a mix of English and Arabic when the gunman confronted them, prosecutors said. Their families said on Monday justice "has been rendered" and that they feel relief. Though Eaton pleaded not guilty, he did not dispute being the shooter. His legal team said he should not be found guilty due to insanity, referring to his claims that US and Israeli intelligence ordered him to carry out the shooting through radio and that God asked him to protect Jewish neighbors. US rights advocates have noted rising [USN:L3N3G64W6 TEXT:"anti-Arab"], [USN:L3N3PQ0BA TEXT:"anti-Muslim"] and [USN:L1N40013V TEXT:"anti-Jewish"] bias since the start of US ally [USN:L6N42U0SO TEXT:"Israel's devastating assault on Gaza"] following a [USN:L8N3BD0H4 TEXT:"deadly October 2023 Hamas attack"] on Israel. Some fatal incidents that have sparked alarm include a 2023 deadly stabbing of a 6-year-old Palestinian American child in Illinois [USN:L4N3RA04Y TEXT:"whose killer was sentenced"] to 53 years in prison and died in custody, and a 2026 [USN:L1N41V0YB TEXT:"San Diego mosque"] shooting that left five dead, including two teenage suspects.

item.title: Nelly Korda won’t play WTGL’s inaugural season, but door ‘not closed’
item.description: World No. 1 Nelly Korda won't participate in the first season of the WTGL, the women's counterpart to the men's indoor golf league co-founded by Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World No. 1 Nelly Korda won't participate in the first season of the WTGL, the women's counterpart to the men's indoor golf league co-founded by Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy. That doesn't mean that Korda is cold on the idea for good. Rufus Hack, the president of golf for Woods' and McIlroy's company TMRW Sports, said at WTGL's media day that TMRW had discussions with Korda's camp. "We had lots of conversations with Nelly and her team, and effectively the decision was made that she wasn't going to participate in Season 1," Hack said. "The door is certainly not closed for season two and beyond, and we continue to have very constructive conversations. And we would love Nelly to be part of WTGL at some point." In the past, Korda explained her stance that both sides would benefit from having LPGA stars tee it up alongside the men -- calling it "a huge and unbelievable miss" in comments to Golfweek back in January. "It would have been the first time that men and women were on the same playing field, playing for the same amount of money," Korda said at the time. "But I also think it's great that we are getting this opportunity, so those are my mixed feelings." Instead, WTGL will launch as a separate product with the league running Nov. 8-Dec. 23, before the third season of TGL picks up in early 2027. The purse has yet to be disclosed. Twenty-five players are signed up for Season 1 -- five teams of five players apiece. Lexi Thompson and Michelle Wie West, though retired from full-time competition, figure to be the biggest stars involved. "We've got 25 of the world's best golfers, huge personalities, as well as world-class players, and we're really focused on who we have got here," Hack said. Korda, 28, has won four LPGA tournaments this year, including her third and fourth major titles at the Chevron Championship and the U.S. Women's Open. She holds the lead in the tour's season-long Race to the CME Globe. --Field Level Media

item.title: UK's Burnham agrees to Saudi request for refuelling support
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday he had agreed to a request from Saudi Arabia to provide defensive air-to-air refuelling for a limited time period, a move he described as helping to stabilise the wider region.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday he had agreed to a request from Saudi Arabia to provide defensive air-to-air refuelling for a limited time period, a move he described as helping to stabilise the wider region. Riyadh requested support after the Houthis, who control the most populous parts of Yemen, intensified [USN:L6N45C051 TEXT:"their attacks on Saudi Arabia"], a new front in the wider war that began with U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran in late February. "We have received a request from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for military support, and on the advice of the defence secretary and the foreign secretary, last night I agreed to that request for defensive air-to-air refuelling," he told reporters as he travelled to New York for a meeting of the United Nations General Assembly. "Because of course Saudi Arabia has been experiencing attack... and we need to keep those pathways open, and hence our agreement to the request," he said. Britain and Saudi Arabia have been close military allies for decades, with Britain serving as one of the kingdom's largest arms suppliers. Earlier this year, Britain deployed its Sky Sabre air defence system to Saudi Arabia to help protect it from Iranian missile attacks during the U.S.-Israeli conflict with Iran. For the new air-to-air refuelling support, Britain will deploy one Voyager plane in the coming days. "That is a time-limited agreement in terms of the assistance that we will provide, but we will keep it under review," he said, adding that Britain was "playing our part" in the Middle East also by supporting efforts to keep the Strait of Hormuz open.

item.title: Hawks C Henri Veesaar tears ACL in workout, to miss ‘26-27
item.description: Atlanta Hawks rookie center Henri Veesaar tore the ACL in his right knee during a workout Sept. 15, the team said Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Atlanta Hawks rookie center Henri Veesaar tore the ACL in his right knee during a workout Sept. 15, the team said Monday. Veesaar has a surgery scheduled for October and the Hawks expect him to miss the 2026-27 season. Veesaar, 22, was the 52nd overall pick in this June's draft by the Los Angeles Clippers. He was traded to the Hawks on the same day for 57th overall pick Narcisse Ngoy and cash. The 7-footer played two seasons at Arizona and spent 2025-26 at North Carolina, where he was selected to the All-ACC second team. Veesaar averaged 17.0 points, 8.7 rebounds, 2.1 assists and 1.2 blocks in 31 games for the Tar Heels. The Hawks also signed guard Issac McKneely on Monday after the undrafted free agent played in seven games for Atlanta's Summer League team. McKneely spent his college career at Virginia (2022-25) and Louisville (2025-26) and was known as a 3-point marksman, making 329 triples in his career on 41.4% shooting. He averaged 11.1 points and 2.7 rebounds over 133 career games, including 10.9 points and 3.0 rebounds at Louisville last year. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trading Day: AI euphoria back with a bang
item.description: Stocks roared higher on Monday, with the Nasdaq coming within 0.02% of June's record high, as the bullish AI narrative burst back into life, while investors also welcomed the fourth consecutive slide in global oil prices.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded:
Stocks roared higher on Monday, with the [USN:L6N45D0B7 TEXT:"Nasdaq"] coming within 0.02% of June's record high, as the bullish AI narrative burst back into life, while investors also welcomed the fourth consecutive slide in global [USN:L1N45D0L9 TEXT:"oil"] prices. If you have time, please dive into the big weekend read by my colleague Ron Bousso and me, on why [USN:L6N4590YX TEXT:"record diesel prices could be Trump's Achilles' heel"] — the surge in prices threatens to push inflation much higher, and taming it will be an epic challenge. Today's Key Reads [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"Xi rolls into Trump summit with China's trade engine roaring"] [USN:L8N45C0DZ TEXT:"Erosion of Germany's political centre exposes Merz's weakening grip on power"] [USN:L8N45A0ZG TEXT:"Why France's budget problems have driven its bond risk premium to 2012 highs"] [USN:L6N45A0SP TEXT:"Hormuz shuttles keep oil flowing, but at a high cost: Bousso"] [USN:L4N45D112 TEXT:"Paramount settles with US states in big step towards closing Warner Bros merger"] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: MSCI World +1.3%, biggest rise in six weeks. [USN:L6N45D08E TEXT:"Europe"] +1%, [USN:L6N45D0C3 TEXT:"UK"] +0.8%. S&P 500 +1.5%, Nasdaq +2.3% to within a whisker of new record highs. SECTORS/SHARES: Eight sectors on the S&P 500 rise, four fall. Tech +2.5%, comms services +4%, energy -2.6%. Chip stocks +4%. Intel +12%, Meta and [USN:L4N45D0YH TEXT:"Advanced Micro Devices"] +11%. Paramount Skydance -3%, [USN:L4N45D112 TEXT:"Warner Bros"] +11%. FX: Dollar rises, [USN:L4N45D01G TEXT:"dollar/yen"] above 157.00. [USN:L4N45D06D TEXT:"Chinese yuan"] strongest since January 2023. Bitcoin +6% through $86,000. BONDS: French-German spread widest since 2012. US yields fall up to 4 bps, curves flatten further — 2s/30s down to 53 bps. COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L4N45C04W TEXT:"Oil"] dips below $100/bbl, Brent -4%, WTI -5%. But average US diesel nudges to new high $6.51/gallon.

Today's Talking Points: European political risk Worries over political risk in [USN:L8N45A0ZG TEXT:"France"], specifically around the public finances outlook, have stalked the French bond market for some time, but have ratcheted up in recent weeks. State elections in euro zone powerhouse Germany at the weekend have suddenly intensified and broadened investors' angst about the whole region's political direction. And, by extension, its debt and deficit trajectory. The 10-year French-German bond yield spread widened to 104 basis points on Friday, the highest since the white heat of the euro zone debt crisis in July 2012, only days before Mario Draghi's famous "whatever it takes" line changed the course of history. It held above 100 bps on Monday. The cost of insuring French bonds against default risk is the highest since 2020. Meanwhile, German Chancellor [USN:L8N45D0G1 TEXT:"Friedrich Merz"] is clinging to power after his party's worst regional election defeat in postwar Germany, although the Bund yields fell on Monday thanks to the global oil price slide. Otherwise, German yields would probably be higher too. Disapproval On the other side of the Atlantic, US President Donald [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"Trump's approval rating"] has sunk to a career low of 32%, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll. The high cost of living, including record-high diesel prices at the pump, and the unpopularity of the Iran war, now in its seventh month with little sign of an end in sight, are beginning to bite. This is not what the Republican party wants with the November 3 midterm elections fast approaching. Rightly or wrongly, the midterms are often referendums on the sitting president. Voters appear to be feeling the downside of persistently elevated inflation and now record high diesel prices more than the positive "wealth effects" from record stock prices and [USN:L6N45716B TEXT:"record household net worth"]. AI optimism strikes back Monday's global equity rally underscored the ebb and flow of investor sentiment around AI. Today, it was overwhelmingly positive, sparking some huge one-day gains in big-cap tech names and lifting the Nasdaq to within 0.02% of the record high 27,190 points struck on June 1. The boom seemed to come out of nowhere. Perhaps Trump and Bessent helped soothe some of investors' concerns. The last few weeks had been dominated by the doomsday narrative that AI will be so powerful and destructive it could wipe out humanity within the decade. Exactly how that might unfold has not been made clear. What is clear, however, is Big Tech's commitment to keep spending, which investors had begun to fret over, but latched onto as a reason to buy on Monday. Will that spending generate the returns investors expect? Who knows. But that wasn't their concern today. What could move markets tomorrow? Global PMIs (September, flash estimates) European Central Bank officials scheduled to speak include vice president Boris Vujcic, chief economist Philip Lane, and board member Piero Cipollone UK public sector borrowing (August) US Treasury sells $69 billion of two-year notes at auction US Federal Reserve officials scheduled to speak include New York Fed President John Williams, Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin, and Vice Chair Philip Jefferson Want to receive Trading Day in your inbox every weekday morning? Sign up for my newsletter here . Opinions expressed are those of the author. They do not reflect the views of Reuters News, which, under the Trust Principles , is committed to integrity, independence, and freedom from bias.

item.title: 米北東部の空港で運航混乱、7000便に影響 通信障害で到着便一時停止
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク、ボストン、フィラデルフィアなど北東部の主要空港で２１日、通信回線の障害と光ファイバーケーブルの切断が重なって到着便の受け入れが一時停止され、航空便の運航が大きく混乱した。米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）はその後、午後遅くに通信障害を解消した。

問題は午前９時４５分ごろ、作業員がニュージャージー州でＦＡＡが使用する通信回線を誤って切断したことで発生した。これにより、主要空港は到着便の受け入れ停止を余儀なくされた。この日は国連総会に出席するため、約１３０人の各国首脳や多数の閣僚がニューヨーク入りしていた。

ＦＡＡはニューヨーク地域の主要３空港に加え、フィラデルフィア、ボストン、およびニューヨーク地域の中小空港２カ所でも到着便を停止した。障害が完全に解消するまでには８時間を要した。

ダフィー運輸長官は午後遅く、Ｘへの投稿で、通信回線が修復され、北東部全域で通常運航が再開しつつあると明らかにした。既存の遅延解消には時間がかかるとし、乗客に対しては待機中の便の運航状況を確認するよう呼びかけた。

航空便追跡サイト「フライトアウェア」によると、米国内で約７０００便が遅延または欠航となり、このうちニューヨーク地域の主要３空港では１４００便が影響を受けた。

ユナイテッド航空の主要拠点であるニューアーク空港では、全便の半数超が欠航となった。

このほか、１００便以上が他の空港への目的地変更を余儀なくされた。

ニュージャージー・トランジットは午後５時半ごろ、大半の光ファイバーケーブルが修復され、間もなく復旧するとの見通しを示した。ニューアーク空港は８時間後に到着便受け入れを再開し、午後の大半にわたり閉鎖されていたニューヨークのラガーディア空港も再開した。 フィラデルフィアの空港では午後遅くに運航が再開した。

item.title: F1 commission agrees shorter races from 2027
item.description: The governing FIA's Formula One commission agreed on Monday to reduce the standard Grand Prix distance from 305km to 290km from 2027, cutting races by two or three laps.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The governing FIA's Formula One commission agreed on Monday to reduce the standard Grand Prix distance from 305km to 290km from 2027, cutting races by two or three laps. The commission approved the change in line with planned refinements to 2027 power unit regulations concerning fuel flow, they said in a statement after a meeting in London at the International Automobile Federation offices. They also agreed to remove the current three-hour maximum time limit from the start to finish of a race, including any interruptions caused by rain or other factors. A two-hour limit on actual racing will remain, while a hard stop time for the end of racing activity will be introduced for disrupted events. The objective is to give spectators the best possible chance to enjoy a full race when disruptions occur, the FIA said. The commission agreed that organisers should also have greater flexibility to extend free practice sessions if they are interrupted. Gearbox homologation will be removed for 2027 following consultation with manufacturers and a recommendation from the Sporting Advisory Committee, a move the FIA said would preserve development freedom for suppliers.

item.title: Governador da Califórnia assina pacote com ampla regulamentação dos data centers
item.description: O governador da Califórnia, Gavin Newsom, assinou nesta segunda-feira sete projetos de lei que visam regulamentar o setor de data centers, que vem crescendo rapidamente, impondo novas exigências em relação aos custos de eletricidade, ao uso da água e à fiscalização local, à medida que comunidades se opõem ao aumento repentino de empreendimentos ligados à inteligência artificial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O governador da Califórnia, Gavin Newsom, assinou nesta segunda-feira sete projetos de lei que visam regulamentar o setor de data centers, que vem crescendo rapidamente, impondo novas exigências em relação aos custos de eletricidade, ao uso da água e à fiscalização local, à medida que comunidades se opõem ao aumento repentino de empreendimentos ligados à inteligência artificial. A legislação exige que os data centers divulguem informações sobre o uso de eletricidade, o consumo de água, o uso do solo e as necessidades de mão de obra, ao mesmo tempo em que fornece às comunidades locais mais informações para avaliar os projetos propostos. As medidas têm como objetivo impedir que o custo da geração de energia elétrica e das melhorias na rede elétrica necessárias para os data centers seja repassado a outros consumidores. “Com essas leis, estamos garantindo que os californianos continuem no comando -- e que aqueles que lucram com os data centers não o façam às nossas custas”, afirmou Newsom em comunicado. A Califórnia informou que a legislação exigirá que os data centers cumpram os requisitos estaduais de aquisição de energia e ajudem a trazer novos suprimentos de energia limpa para a rede elétrica. As medidas surgem em meio à crescente preocupação em todo o país com o impacto dos data centers sobre a demanda por eletricidade, os recursos hídricos e a infraestrutura local, à medida que as empresas de tecnologia correm para expandir suas capacidades de inteligência artificial. A rápida expansão dos data centers de IA gerou resistência na Califórnia e em outros lugares, com moradores e grupos de defesa levantando preocupações sobre as contas de luz e a poluição associadas às instalações. A Data Center Coalition, uma associação setorial, afirmou que seus membros estão comprometidos com o desenvolvimento responsável, mas alertou que as medidas podem levar os projetos a outros Estados. “Legislações como essas criam incerteza significativa e introduzem requisitos potencialmente redundantes que tornam a atuação na Califórnia uma proposta pouco atraente para data centers e outros setores”, disse Khara Boender, diretora de assuntos governamentais do grupo, em comunicado. “É provável que isso limite ainda mais o desenvolvimento de data centers na Califórnia -- um mercado já em declínio --, o que direciona a geração de empregos, a implantação de energia limpa e a arrecadação de impostos para os Estados vizinhos.”

item.title: EU to keep opposing new Arctic oil drilling, despite pressure from Norway
item.description: The European Union will maintain its opposition to new oil and gas drilling in the Arctic, a European Commission spokesperson said on Monday, despite Norwegian pressure to drop the EU ban.
item.dc:creator: Kate Abnett
item.content:encoded: The European Union will maintain its opposition to new oil and gas drilling in the Arctic, a European Commission spokesperson said on Monday, despite Norwegian pressure to drop the EU ban. The EU currently supports a ban on new drilling in the Arctic, over environmental concerns, including the risk posed to sensitive Arctic ecosystems by industrial activities and pollution. It is facing calls from Norway to change this stance in an upcoming revision of the EU's policy on the Arctic. "The EU remains committed to the approach set out in the 2021 Joint Communication on the EU Arctic Policy," a spokesperson for the European Commission told Reuters on Monday, adding that work is ongoing on the revised policy. The document the spokesperson referred to sets out the EU position: it says the bloc supports a ban on further Arctic oil and gas development and will not purchase such hydrocarbons. Norway is Europe's biggest gas supplier. Norway, which is not an EU member, has been pushing Brussels to drop the moratorium. With many ageing fields, Norwegian production is set to decline in the 2030s unless companies such as Equinor (EQNR.OL) make new discoveries outside mature areas. Norway's energy minister Terje Aasland [USN:L1N44L06P TEXT:"told Reuters"] last month that the country will continue developing its oil and gas resources in the Barents Sea regardless of the EU's support, and cited an unstable geopolitical and security environment as reasons why this is in Europe's interest. Europe is heavily reliant on imported oil and gas, and is racing to reduce that dependency after suffering two sharp energy shocks: former top gas supplier Russia slashing gas deliveries in 2022, and surging global energy prices this year as the Iran war upends global oil and gas markets. Some [USN:L6N4230EA TEXT:"investors "]and environmental campaigners have urged the EU to maintain its opposition to new Arctic drilling. They say new Arctic fossil fuel developments would take more than a decade to come online, making them ineffective in addressing Europe's current energy woes. The EU is scheduled to publish its new Arctic policy on October 20.

item.title: Texas Governor Abbott halts all state-issued permits for data centers until grid audit is complete
item.description: Texas Governor Greg Abbott on Monday barred the state's environmental agency from issuing new permits for data centers until regulators complete a massive audit of the energy-hungry facilities seeking to connect to the Texas electrical grid.
item.dc:creator: Liz Hampton, Laila Kearney
item.content:encoded: Texas Governor Greg Abbott on Monday barred the state's environmental agency from issuing new permits for data centers until regulators complete a massive audit of the energy-hungry facilities seeking to connect to the Texas electrical grid. The Republican governor's directive to the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality effectively freezes all state-issued permits to data center developers, which had flocked to the region for its abundant electricity, land and pro-business reputation. Since the artificial intelligence boom began roughly three years ago, Texas has become one of the fastest-growing data hubs in the world. But intensifying public backlash over the facilities, and fears about AI more broadly, prompted Abbott last month to [USN:L6N44912S TEXT:"freeze the connection"] of new data centers to the state grid and order an audit of the facilities. By the time of that directive, there were more than 470 gigawatts' worth of data center projects and other large energy users in line to connect to the grid — more than five times the state's peak demand. The Electric Reliability Council of Texas, which operates the state grid, is in the early stages of auditing data center power use, tax incentives and water consumption, among other factors. “Simply put, Texans must come first,” Abbott said in a statement. “Data centers must pay their own way, protect our grid and water, and complete the (audits)." Abbott is among a swelling number of governors who once raced to attract data center investments — and touted their public benefit — but are now tightening restrictions on the developments to ease their constituents' fears about rising power bills and environmental issues caused by the facilities. Ed Hirs, an energy fellow at the University of Houston, said Abbott was walking back "his earlier pronouncements about data centers leading to lower electricity prices."

item.title: Blue Jays activate RHP Trey Yesavage (knee) from IL
item.description: The Toronto Blue Jays activated right-hander Trey Yesavage from the injured list Monday and is slated to start the opener of a key three-game series against the Baltimore Orioles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Toronto Blue Jays activated right-hander Trey Yesavage from the injured list Monday and is slated to start the opener of a key three-game series against the Baltimore Orioles. The Blue Jays also recalled right-hander Chad Dallas from Triple-A Buffalo, optioned right-hander Spencer Arrighetti to the Florida Complex League and designated left-hander Joe Mantiply for assignment. Yesavage, 23, has been out since Aug. 4 with a left knee injury that required a surgical procedure. He is 5-5 with a 3.65 ERA in 18 starts this season. The Blue Jays are three games out of the final wild-card spot in the American League and will need plenty of help in order to return to the playoffs. Dallas, 26, made his major league debut in June and went 2-1 with a 6.10 ERA in four relief appearances. Arrighetti, 26, is 9-9 with a 4.96 ERA in 24 appearances (19 starts) for the Houston Astros and Blue Jays this season. Mantiply, 35, went 2-0 with a 3.33 ERA in 25 relief appearances for Toronto this season. In nine major leagues seasons, including six with the Arizona Diamondbacks, he is 13-13 with a 4.41 ERA in 281 appearances (five starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: British PM Andy Burnham seeks resolution to dispute over Diego Garcia base
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday he was determined to find a resolution to the disputed status of a U.S.-British military base on the Indian Ocean island of Diego Garcia.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Piper
item.content:encoded: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday he was determined to find a resolution to the disputed status of a U.S.-British military base on the Indian Ocean island of Diego Garcia. Britain last year agreed a deal to cede sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius after more than two centuries of control, while retaining a 99-year lease over its biggest island, Diego Garcia, and its strategic military base. But the legislation required to implement the agreement was paused because of opposition from the United States with U.S. President Donald Trump describing the deal earlier this year as a "big mistake". Speaking to reporters on the way to New York for a meeting of the United Nations General Assembly, Burnham said he would work with Mauritius and the United States to find a solution, acknowledging that no agreement had yet been reached. "We remain determined to secure the long-term operation of the base, which is crucial to our security and that of our allies," he said. Earlier, Burnham spoke to his Mauritian counterpart, Navin Ramgoolam, and they agreed their foreign ministers should meet at the U.N. General Assembly, according to a statement from Downing Street. "The assurance I gave was I will work towards a resolution," Burnham said. "At the moment we don't have that, but I gave an assurance that I would commit to working towards one". While Britain has already signed the treaty with Mauritius, the bill needed to enact the handover has yet to complete its passage through the British parliament. Under the deal negotiated by Burnham's predecessor, Britain would retain control of Diego Garcia base for almost a century in return for payments to Mauritius worth 101 million pounds ($134.99 million) per year - calculated to be worth 3.4 billion pounds over the lifetime of the deal. ($1 = 0.7482 pounds)

item.title: Soja sobe em Chicago com expectativa de que China compre mais produtos dos EUA
item.description: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago subiram nesta segunda-feira, com os operadores antecipando que uma reunião entre o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, e o presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, nesta semana, poderia estimular mais compras chinesas de produtos norte-americanos.
item.dc:creator: Tom Polansek
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago subiram nesta segunda-feira, com os operadores antecipando que uma reunião entre o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, e o presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, nesta semana, poderia estimular mais compras chinesas de produtos norte-americanos. Os operadores concentraram-se na reunião de quinta-feira, pois a China é o maior importador mundial de soja. O chefe do Treasury dos EUA, Scott Bessent, afirmou ter mantido conversas bem-sucedidas com os chineses sobre questões comerciais no fim de semana. "Há um otimismo esperançoso em relação ao que vai acontecer na reunião de quinta-feira", disse Jim Gerlach, presidente da corretora de commodities A/C Trading, com sede em Indiana. O contrato novembro da soja fechou em alta de 24,5 centavos, a US$13,28 por bushel. A Casa Branca informou em maio que a China havia se comprometido a comprar pelo menos US$17 bilhões em produtos agrícolas dos EUA nos anos de 2026, 2027 e 2028, após reuniões entre Trump e Xi. Compradores estatais chineses têm adquirido soja dos EUA. No entanto, os operadores esperam que compradores privados chineses possam retomar as compras caso Pequim remova uma tarifa de importação de 10%, disse Matt Ammermann, gerente de risco de commodities da StoneX. "A soja e o milho estão sendo sustentados pelas esperanças de que a China aumente as compras de produtos dos EUA caso as negociações entre Trump e Xi nesta semana resultem em algum tipo de acordo comercial ou redução de tarifas", disse ele. O contrato dezembro do milho fechou em alta de 15,5 centavos, a US$5,43 por bushel. O trigo fechou em alta de 12,5 centavos, cotado a US$7,2675 por bushel. O trigo subiu depois que ataques com drones pela Ucrânia e pela Rússia reduziram as esperanças de uma distensão no conflito entre os dois países, o que praticamente paralisou as exportações de grãos do Mar Negro.

item.title: Açúcar bruto se recupera após atingir mínima de 3 semanas e meia; cacau também sobe
item.description: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram nesta segunda-feira, recuperando-se após atingirem a menor cotação em três semanas e meia no início do pregão, enquanto o cacau se recuperou de uma mínima de quase seis semanas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram nesta segunda-feira, recuperando-se após atingirem a menor cotação em três semanas e meia no início do pregão, enquanto o cacau se recuperou de uma mínima de quase seis semanas. AÇÚCAR * O açúcar bruto fechou em alta de 0,12 centavo, ou 0,7%, a 17,48 centavos por libra-peso, após atingir uma mínima de três semanas e meia, de 17,26 centavos. * O açúcar bruto atingiu uma máxima de 15 meses no início deste mês, mas, desde então, vem sofrendo pressão devido à realização de lucros por parte de investidores que aguardam os resultados dos danos climáticos associados ao El Niño, segundo corretores. * Por outro lado, o açúcar continua sendo sustentado pela menor produção de beterraba na Europa, pelas perspectivas de redução da produção na Ásia para 2026/27 devido à falta de chuvas e pela menor produção no Brasil, principal produtor, em razão do excesso de chuvas. * A produção de cana-de-açúcar na Indonésia deve cair cerca de 25% este ano devido às condições de seca e aos incêndios florestais. * O preço do açúcar branco caiu 0,3%, para US$507,50 por tonelada métrica. CACAU * O cacau em Londres fechou em alta de £27, ou 0,7%, a £3.961 por tonelada, após atingir uma mínima de quase seis semanas de £ 4.036. * As chegadas de cacau aos portos da Costa do Marfim, principal produtor, totalizaram 16.000 toneladas métricas na semana encerrada em 20 de setembro, para um total de 20.500 toneladas desde o início da safra 2026/27. * "A oferta confortável no curto prazo continuou a pesar sobre o mercado. Os estoques (de cacau) monitorados pela bolsa permanecem relativamente abundantes, enquanto a recuperação da demanda tem sido lenta, já que os fabricantes continuam se esforçando para reduzir o uso de cacau", afirmou o ING em uma nota. * Acrescentou, no entanto, que o cacau continua apoiado por um déficit de oferta previsto para 2026/27. * A precipitação ficou abaixo da média na semana passada na maioria das principais regiões produtoras de cacau da Costa do Marfim, e os agricultores afirmaram que as condições de seca poderiam ameaçar o desenvolvimento da safra principal, que vai de setembro a fevereiro. * O contrato de cacau da Bolsa de Nova York subiu 0,5%, para US$5.351 por tonelada. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em baixa de 4,1 centavos, ou 1,5%, a US$2,764 por libra-peso, após atingir uma mínima de três meses de US$2,7425. * O café está sob pressão geral devido ao aumento nos estoques de arábica na ICE, ao crescimento das exportações do Brasil, principal produtor, e às condições climáticas favoráveis no Brasil e no Vietnã. * Os cafeeiros no Brasil estão florescendo mais cedo, levando analistas a prever que a safra de 2027 também possa amadurecer mais cedo e antecipar o aumento da oferta global. * O café robusta caiu 1,7%, para US$3.337 a tonelada. O mercado atingiu, mais cedo, uma mínima de mais de três meses, a US$ 3.307. (Reportagem de May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira) ((Tradução Redação São Paulo 55 11 56447751)) REUTERS RS

item.content:encoded:
中国、ボーイング機200機購入に向け進展＝米通商代表 5:27 配信

２０２５年４月撮影　REUTERS/Kevin Mohatt

David Shepardson

[２１日 ロイター] - グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表は２１日、中国が５月に発表した米ボーイング製航空機２００機の購入計画について、履行に向け進展が見られていると述べた。

グリア氏はＦＯＸニュースに対し、中国によるボーイング機の発注について「約１４０機は順調に進んでいる状況にある。さらに約１０機についても発注手続きが進められている」と語った。ただ、２４日に予定されるトランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席の会談を前に、中国がボーイング機を追加発注するかについては言及しなかった。

中国商務省は５月、ボーイング製ジェット機２００機を購入すると発表。中国政府がボーイング機の発注を公式に認めたのは初めてだった。トランプ大統領はその後、ボーイング機購入数は最大７５０機に達する可能性があると述べていた。

item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩ、米主導のＡＩ国際標準策定を要請　国連総会で議論へ 5:25 配信

2026年9月15日、オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）。REUTERS/Carlos Barria/File Photo

Michelle Nichols

[国連 ２１日 ロイター] -  人工知能（ＡＩ）大手のオープンＡＩは２１日、最先端ＡＩの世界的な技術標準策定に向けた国際的な取り組みで米国が主導的な役割を果たすよう求めた。標準策定の対象には、ＡＩシステムが自らの能力を自律的に高める「再帰的自己改善」も含まれる。

ＡＩは今週の国連総会ハイレベル会合で主要な議題となる見通しだ。オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を含む複数のＡＩ業界の指導者が、ＡＩが近い将来に自ら改良を重ねて人間の制御を超える恐れがあると警告し、技術の開発を協調して減速させるよう求めている。

オープンＡＩは、国連会合に先駆けて公表したブログ投稿で、より良い集団的行動に向けて、各国と国際的な最先端標準を補完し合う仕組みを、共通の測定手法やインシデント（事案）報告の手順とともに整備することが不可欠だと指摘。「今、主導権を握ることが、米国が世界のＡＩの枠組みを形成するのか、それとも分断され、不均衡で、対立に満ちた体制が周囲に定着するのを傍観することになるのかを決める。これはまた、先進的なＡＩが米国とその同盟国が既に持つネットワークを強化するのかどうかも左右する。主導できなければ、それらを弱める恐れがある」と記した。

ＡＩが将来的に人間に危害を及ぼしかねないとの懸念を踏まえ、業界では意図的な開発の減速、いわゆる「ペーシング（ペース調整）」が議論されている。

オープンＡＩは「ＡＩ開発のペーシングとは、あらかじめ決められた速度を維持することではない。技術的には、アライメント（整合性）の研究とその成果の導入が、能力の向上に先行し続けるよう確保することだ」と述べた。アライメントは、ＡＩが人間の価値観に沿って行動するようにするものだ。

アルトマン氏は２３日、１５理事国で構成する国連安全保障理事会に対し、ＡＩと国際安全保障について説明する予定だ。

item.title: Canada sees scope for France LNG partnership, minister says
item.description: Canada could pursue an energy partnership with France involving liquefied natural gas from its Pacific coast, Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand said on Monday, a day after leaders of the two countries met and discussed energy cooperation.
item.dc:creator: John Irish
item.content:encoded: Canada could pursue an energy partnership with France involving liquefied natural gas from its Pacific coast, Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand said on Monday, a day after leaders of the two countries met and discussed [USN:L8N45A14H TEXT:"energy cooperation"]. Anand said it was "quite conceivable" for Canada to execute an energy partnership with a European country using LNG exported from Canada's west coast. "That goes for France," she said in an interview on the sidelines of the annual gathering of world leaders at the United Nations. French President Emmanuel [USN:L8N45A14H TEXT:"Macron"] has repeatedly called in recent days for deeper energy cooperation with Canada as Europe seeks to diversify supplies amid disruptions linked to the conflict in the Middle East and rising energy prices. Canada, the world's fifth-largest natural gas producer, shipped its first-ever liquefied natural gas export cargo in June from the recently constructed LNG Canada facility in British Columbia, which is led by Shell (SHEL.L) and is the first North American LNG export site with direct access to the Pacific Ocean. Anand said discussions on energy partnerships were taking place with countries around the world across a range of sectors including LNG, clean energy, wind, solar and nuclear power. "Every country I speak with asks about potential partnerships in energy," she said. Anand pointed to discussions earlier this year between [USN:L6N3UJ0RK TEXT:"Canada and Germany"] involving LNG supplies destined for Asia through a swap arrangement, under which Germany benefits from third-party sales rather than direct shipments. "There is a host of potential deals and relationships that we can execute on energy," she said, adding that Canada was looking to match its energy expertise with the needs of partner countries. German state-controlled energy group Uniper (UN0k.DE) at the end of July also finalised a 20-year liquefied natural gas purchase deal with Canada. Asked about prospects for cooperation with France, Anand said the same logic applied. Anand said energy would be among the topics discussed when she hosts Germany's foreign minister in Canada later this week, alongside critical minerals and artificial intelligence. She said Ottawa was seeking to deepen ties not only with the European Union as a bloc but also with individual member states. "What Canada is doing is deepening its relationship not simply with the EU as a whole, but with individual countries within the EU to ensure that our domestic population benefits," she said.

item.title: Canada aims to cut time needed for project reviews, and address strikes
item.description: Canada on Monday unveiled draft legislation that would speed up the approval process for major natural resource projects, a goal Prime Minister Mark Carney says is necessary to help deal with US tariffs.
item.dc:creator: David Ljunggren, Amanda Stephenson
item.content:encoded: Canada on Monday unveiled draft legislation that would speed up the approval process for major natural resource projects, a goal Prime Minister Mark Carney says is necessary to help deal with US tariffs. The bill would also make it more complicated for a labor minister to order striking workers in major industries back to work. Ottawa stepped in several times in 2024 and 2025 to settle work stoppages in crucial sectors, prompting union anger. Carney has said Canada has to cut back on obstacles to growth, in particular streamlining a complex federal approval process for infrastructure projects. Lengthy permitting times are one reason why some energy and resource projects in Canada have taken a decade or more to move from proposal to completion. ONE-YEAR APPROVAL TARGET The new bill will establish a one-year time frame for federal reviews and decisions, in part by conducting federal permit processes and reviews simultaneously instead of one after another. The bill sends a signal to the federal bureaucracy that it must become more efficient, said federal Natural Resources Minister Tim Hodgson in an interview, adding the civil service will be held accountable to the new one-year time frame. "What this is doing is signaling to every part of government that we need to raise our competence. We need to do our environmental work better and faster," Hodgson said. The government stressed that achieving the one-year timeline was not wholly dependent on the regulatory process, but would also require project proponents to provide data and project information in a timely manner. The new bill does not change the right of Indigenous groups in Canada to be consulted and accommodated on projects that are taking place on their territory, but Hodgson said those consultations need to be done better and faster. Carney's ruling Liberals have a majority in the House of Commons elected chamber, ensuring the legislation should eventually pass. Opposition parties could demand changes and drag out the approval process. LABOUR CODE CHANGES The bill also aims to address an article in the Labour Code allowing the jobs minister to quickly end strikes and lockouts to "maintain or secure industrial peace". Ottawa has invoked this article to end disputes in crucial sectors like railways, ports, airlines and postal services, to the outrage of unions. Ottawa now says that in major disputes, a special mediator would have to work with the parties for 21 days. The minister could not intervene before then hearing a report from the mediator as well as receiving an assessment from the federal employment ministry as to the damage a stoppage could do.

item.title: Nasdaq tem fechamento recorde, conforme volta otimismo sobre IA e rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro recuam
item.description: O Nasdaq atingiu um recorde de fechamento na segunda-feira, impulsionado pelas valorizações da Advanced Micro Devices e de outras grandes empresas do setor de inteligência artificial, enquanto os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro recuaram em relação às máximas recentes e os preços do petróleo bruto caíram para a menor cotação em 11 dias, em meio a especulações sobre um possível avanço nas negociações sobre o Oriente Médio em uma reunião da ONU nesta semana.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich, Johann Cherian
item.content:encoded: O Nasdaq atingiu um recorde de fechamento na segunda-feira, impulsionado pelas valorizações da Advanced Micro Devices e de outras grandes empresas do setor de inteligência artificial, enquanto os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro recuaram em relação às máximas recentes e os preços do petróleo bruto caíram para a menor cotação em 11 dias, em meio a especulações sobre um possível avanço nas negociações sobre o Oriente Médio em uma reunião da ONU nesta semana. As ações do setor de chips registraram alta, com a Intel (INTC.O) saltando 12,2% e a Arm Holdings disparando 17%. O índice de chips PHLX (.SOX) subiu 4,3%. A Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) subiu cerca de 10%, atingindo pela primeira vez uma capitalização de mercado de US$ 1 trilhão. O Nasdaq registrou seu primeiro fechamento recorde desde 2 de junho, enquanto o S&P 500 encerrou cerca de 0,4% abaixo de seu fechamento recorde de 13 de agosto. Os investidores apontaram sinais que sugerem que os gastos com IA continuam em expansão, apesar dos recentes alertas de segurança emitidos pelos líderes das gigantes da IA há uma semana, que provocaram uma onda global de vendas no setor de tecnologia. O rendimento de referência dos títulos de 10 anos dos EUA caiu abaixo do nível psicologicamente importante de 5%, enquanto os futuros do petróleo Brent caíram abaixo de US$100 o barril, atingindo seu nível mais baixo desde 9 de setembro, para depois fechar em US$100,34 o barril. Enquanto Washington e Teerã trocavam ameaças ao longo do fim de semana, o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou que estaria aberto a se reunir com o presidente iraniano, Masoud Pezeshkian, que deve participar da Assembleia Geral da ONU em Nova York nesta semana. “Fomos, de certa forma, condicionados a acompanhar o preço do petróleo e o rendimento dos títulos de 10 anos dos EUA, e se você observar esses dois fatores hoje, eles passaram de fatores adversos para favoráveis para este mercado, pelo menos no curto prazo”, disse Art Hogan, estrategista-chefe de mercado da B. Riley Wealth. As ações da Meta (META.O) dispararam 11,4% depois que o Wells Fargo elevou seu preço-alvo para a plataforma de mídia social, após o recente lançamento de seu assistente de IA, o Muse. O S&P 500 subiu 1,49%, encerrando o pregão em 7.764,70 pontos. O Nasdaq teve alta de 2,26%, para 27.122,09 pontos, enquanto o Índice Dow Jones Industrial avançou 0,71%, para 52.048,83 pontos. Os investidores continuaram cautelosos em relação às perspectivas para as taxas de juros depois que o Federal Reserve elevou as taxas na semana passada pela primeira vez em três anos para combater a inflação. Os operadores veem 50% de chance de outro aumento no mês que vem, segundo o FedWatch da CME. Estão previstos comentários de pelo menos 10 formuladores de política monetária nesta semana. As ações de empresas com exposição à Groenlândia, listadas nos Estados Unidos, subiram após avanços nas negociações diplomáticas entre os Estados Unidos e a Dinamarca sobre o status da Groenlândia. A Greenland Mines (GRML.O) triplicou de valor, enquanto a Greenland Energy (GLND.O) mais que dobrou. Uma cúpula entre a China e os EUA na quinta-feira poderá abordar temas como a possível prorrogação da trégua comercial entre as duas superpotências, a guerra no Irã e a regulamentação da IA. Um relatório indicou que os EUA propuseram prorrogar a trégua comercial por seis meses, enquanto a China buscava uma prorrogação mais longa. O bitcoin , um importante indicador de tolerância ao risco, subiu mais de 6%, atingindo a maior alta em mais de sete meses, impulsionando a Coinbase (COIN.O) e a Strategy (MSTR.O) . A Paramount Skydance (PSKY.O) caiu quase 3% depois que uma fonte informou à Reuters que a empresa havia chegado a um acordo com a Califórnia e outros 11 Estados que moviam uma ação judicial para impedir sua fusão de US$110 bilhões com a Warner Bros Discovery (WBD.O) . Oito dos 11 índices setoriais do S&P 500 subiram, liderados pelo setor de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) , com alta de 4,16%, seguido por um ganho de 2,4% no setor de tecnologia da informação (.SPLRCT) .

item.title: Foto de Lula preso segurando placa com número 171 é falsa
item.description: Uma imagem do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva preso segurando uma placa com o número 171 é falsa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Uma imagem do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva preso segurando uma placa com o número 171 é falsa. Estes são os principais detalhes: A imagem , que circula no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads, mostra o presidente de camiseta vermelha com uma placa de identificação onde se lê “Polícia Federal. Lula da Silva. 171.542. 1980”. A foto foi gerada por IA , segundo a ferramenta da OpenAI que detecta o uso de tecnologia da empresa em conteúdos criados com suas ferramentas. Lula de fato foi detido em 1980, na ditadura militar. No entanto, a foto de sua prisão é em preto e branco, e o político está com uma placa que diz “Dops. 80. Nº 12712”. Na época, o presidente era líder sindical e foi preso por encabeçar uma greve no ABC Paulista. O Departamento de Ordem Política e Social (Dops) de São Paulo, não a Polícia Federal (PF), foi responsável pela detenção de Lula. Os Dops eram órgãos estaduais de repressão a opositores da ditadura. A imagem gerada por IA faz referência ao artigo 171 do Código Penal , que define o crime de estelionato. Em 1980, Lula foi enquadrado na Lei de Segurança Nacional. Veredicto: Falso. A foto de Lula preso com uma placa “171” foi gerada por IA e não se parece com o registro verdadeiro da sua detenção em 1980. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: Lula diz que não aplicará reciprocidade enquanto estiver negociando com EUA
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva disse nesta segunda-feira que não aplicará a lei de reciprocidade enquanto o Brasil estiver em negociações comerciais com os Estados Unidos, após a imposição de tarifas a produtos brasileiros pelo presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva disse nesta segunda-feira que não aplicará a lei de reciprocidade enquanto o Brasil estiver em negociações comerciais com os Estados Unidos, após a imposição de tarifas a produtos brasileiros pelo presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump. "Nós estamos negociando, e de novo, enquanto ainda estamos na mesa de negociações, eu não tenho que aplicar a lei da reciprocidade. Eu tenho que ser mais paciente. Mas é importante você saber que se não há acordo, nós vamos ter que aplicar a lei da reciprocidade", disse o presidente em entrevista à CNN Internacional. Lula destacou o fato de ter falado com Trump recentemente e, depois da conversa, as negociações terem sido reabertas. A primeira reunião, virtual, entre o ministro do Desenvolvimento, Indústria e Comércio, Márcio Elias Rosa, e o representante de Comércio dos EUA, Jamieson Greer, ocorreu há cerca de três semanas e serviu para reabrir as conversas, mas o governo brasileiro não espera avanços pelo menos até depois das eleições. Lula foi perguntado se pretendia seguir o caminho do Canadá e entrar em uma guerra tarifária com os EUA, caso as negociações não avancem. O presidente negou, e disse que se for necessário terá que analisar com cuidado as medidas a serem tomadas dentro da lei da reciprocidade. "Eu não quero entrar em uma guerra de tarifas com os EUA e nem com qualquer outro país. O que eu quero é negociar e acredito em negociações", afirmou. IMPERADOR Em Nova York para a abertura das Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas, Lula pode encontrar de novo com o presidente norte-americano nos corredores da ONU, apesar de não haver nenhuma negociação para uma conversa. Os dois mantêm um relacionamento pessoal, apesar do momento entre os governos não ser dos melhores. Na entrevista, Lula admitiu que teme interferências dos Estados Unidos na eleição brasileira, especialmente do secretário de Estado, Marco Rubio, mas que até agora são apenas suspeitas. Apesar de ter aberto um canal direto com Trump, Lula voltou a dizer que o norte-americano se comporta como "um imperador", mas afirmou que não está tentando "desafiar os EUA", como colocou a entrevistadora. "Não se trata de desafiar os EUA, se trata de dizer que todo país tem sua soberania, todo mundo cuida dos seus interesses e os EUA não podem impor regras a ninguém", disse.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、対円で157円台半ば 引き続き介入警戒
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げの可能性が意...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、対円で157円台半ば　引き続き介入警戒 5:06 配信

２００９年１１月撮影　REUTERS/Yuriko Nakao

［ニューヨーク　２１日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げの可能性が意識される中、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して上昇した。前週１８日に日銀が「レートチェック」を実施したと報じられたことを受け、日本が連休に入り市場流動性が低下する中、政府・日銀による円買い・ドル売り介入に対する警戒が高まっている。

終盤の取引で円は対ドルで０．３８％安の１５７．４８円。

日銀は１８日まで開いた金融政策決定会合で、政策金利である無担保コールレート翌日物の誘導目標を１．０％程度から１．２５％程度に引き上げると決定。利上げは６月以来３カ月ぶりで、政策金利は１９９５年４月以来約３１年ぶりの高水準となった。日銀の利上げには浅田統一郎委員と佐藤綾野委員が反対し、決定は７対２。利上げ決定後、円は急落したが、その後、日本経済新聞が日本当局による「レートチェック」が実施されたと報じたことを受け、小幅ながら持ち直した。レートチェックは為替介入の準備段階とされ、介入警戒感が高まった。

ニューヨークのバノックバーン・キャピタル・マーケッツのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「日本が連休中だった４月下旬から５月初旬にかけて当局が為替介入を実施したことが市場で思い起こされているが、１ドル＝１５７円台前半から半ばの水準で介入が行われる可能性は低い」と指摘。「世界主要国を比べると、米国の経済は相対的に最も良好な状況にある」とし、米国の金利が高止まりする限り、相場は一定のレンジ内で推移するとの見方を示した。

今月は日銀のほか、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）と欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）も利上げを決定。ＦＲＢとＥＣＢは、中東で約７カ月続く戦争が一因となっているインフレを抑制するために一段の利上げが必要になる可能性があると示唆している。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定する確率は５５．４％。１週間前は４３．５％だった。

この日はセントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁がＦＲＢはインフレ抑制に向け追加利上げを実施しなくてはならない可能性が高いと述べたほか、 シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁もインフレ率が目標に向けて低下しなければ利上げが必要になるとの見方を示した。

終盤の取引で主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１３％高の１００．４０。

ユーロ／ドルは０．１４％安の１．１４６７ドル。ドイツ北東部メクレンブルク・フォアポンメルン州で２０日実施された州議会選挙で、反移民などを掲げる極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」が第１党になり、メルツ首相率いる保守陣営が戦後最悪の地方選敗北を喫したことがユーロ相場の重しになった。

英ポンド／ドル は０．１８％安の１．３３６９ドル。

item.title: Moldovan leaders say will seek parliament's ok to declare energy, water emergency
item.description: Moldova's pro-European leaders said on Monday that they were asking parliament to declare a state of emergency for energy and water supply in connection with dangerously low levels on the Dniester River it shares with Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Tanas
item.content:encoded: Moldova's pro-European leaders said on Monday that they were asking parliament to declare a state of emergency for energy and water supply in connection with dangerously low levels on the Dniester River it shares with Ukraine. Prime Minister Vasile Tofan, writing on social media after a meeting of Moldova's Security Council, said the government would present the appeal to the chamber on Tuesday to give the administration the powers needed to tackle difficulties. He said giving the government a free hand to act was critical as Moldova secured much of its gas, oil and electricity from outside the country. "We can't afford to wait for a crisis to start looking for solutions. This will give the government the necessary tools to step in at the first sign of need—and only where it's truly necessary," Tofan wrote. "The government will be ready to provide the economy and citizens with water, electricity, and heat, and vulnerable households with the support they need." President Maia Sandu, who has spearheaded a drive for Moldova to join the European Union by 2030, had earlier chaired the Security Council meeting and said its members had recommended introducing emergency regulations quickly. "The share of renewable energy sources has increased, but we still don't have the necessary capacity to cover consumption during peak hours," she told a press conference. "However, we need to be ready for any changes and provide solutions, no matter what is going on outside the country." Moldova's government has been concerned with low levels on the Dniester for months. A joint meeting of Moldovan and Ukrainian experts last month [USN:L8N4480G5 TEXT:"reduced flows"] through the Dniester hydropower station in southern Ukraine to permit irrigation of crops in Moldova. The situation on the Dniester was further complicated last March by a Russian [USN:L1N40508X TEXT:"attack"] on the hydropower plant that triggered an oil spill and polluted water systems in Moldova.

item.title: Ibovespa fecha em alta com aval externo e nova pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta segunda-feira, ultrapassando os 187 mil pontos no melhor momento, em meio a um ambiente favorável a risco no mercado internacional, com alívio nos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro norte-americano e queda dos preços do petróleo.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta segunda-feira, ultrapassando os 187 mil pontos no melhor momento, em meio a um ambiente favorável a risco no mercado internacional, com alívio nos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro norte-americano e queda dos preços do petróleo. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) avançou 0,74%, a 186.595,60 pontos, com investidores também repercutindo nova pesquisa eleitoral. Na máxima do dia, chegou a 187.434,25 pontos. Na mínima, marcou 185.246,81 pontos. O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$27,79 bilhões. Nos Estados Unidos, o índice acionário S&P 500 (.SPX) encerrou com acréscimo de 1,49%, apoiado por ações de empresas ligadas à inteligência artificial, em sessão marcada pelo recuo nos preços do petróleo, o que apoiou a queda nos rendimentos do Treasuries, como título de 10 anos marcando 4,953% no final do dia, de 4,996% na sexta-feira. De acordo com o economista-chefe e sócio-fundador da Forum Investimentos, Bruno Perri, embora a cotação do petróleo siga em patamar elevado, o movimento de queda favorece uma melhora no humor externo, uma vez que apoia perspectivas mais positivas para a inflação e para a curva de juros, com reflexos no apetite a risco. Na cena eleitoral brasileira, nova [USN:S8N44200V TEXT:"pesquisa BTG/Nexus"] mostrou que o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) reduziu sua vantagem sobre o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) no primeiro turno da eleição presidencial de outubro e seguiu numericamente à frente no segundo turno por um ponto percentual, embora ambos permaneçam em empate técnico. Também está previsto para a sessão um novo levantamento Quaest sobre a disputa pelo Palácio do Planalto. A disputa acirrada indicada em pesquisas até o momento, com melhora principalmente no desempenho de Flávio, tem repercutido positivamente na bolsa, uma vez que alimenta apostas de mudança no poder em Brasília. De acordo com Perri, a possibilidade de vitória de Flávio endossa perspectivas fiscais melhores. Ainda no radar do dia, [USN:L6N45D0I7 TEXT:"pesquisa Focus"] mostrou que economistas consultados pelo Banco Central passaram a ver a Selic em 13,50% ao ano ao final de 2026, de 13,75% estimados na semana anterior, entre outros ajustes nas projeções para o crescimento da economia e para a inflação neste ano. Dados da B3 mostraram nova saída líquida de estrangeiros das ações brasileiras no último dia 17, reduzindo o saldo positivo acumulado em setembro para R$5,597 bilhões, de R$6,287 bilhões até o dia 16. DESTAQUES ITAÚ PN fechou em alta de 1,77%, com a maioria dos bancos do Ibovespa no azul. BTG PACTUAL UNIT avançou 3,42%, SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT subiu 1,53% e BRADESCO PN encerrou com acréscimo de 0,94%. A exceção foi BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) , que terminou com declínio de 0,91%, tendo no radar dados operacionais da BB Seguridade. Analistas do Bank of America também afirmaram que continuam seletivos sobre bancos na América Latina, acrescentando que, no Brasil, preferem Itaú, "dada sua rentabilidade, balanço sólido e execução de primeira linha", enquanto mantêm uma postura cautelosa em relação ao Banco do Brasil, "devido às pressões sobre a qualidade dos ativos". VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuou 1,12%, em meio ao movimento modesto dos futuros do minério de ferro na China. No setor de mineração e siderurgia, CSN ON (CSNA3.SA) saltou 6,5% e foi o destaque positivo após duas quedas seguidas, sendo que apenas na sexta-feira o papel caiu 6,4%. USIMINAS PNA fechou com acréscimo de 0,14% e GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) avançou 0,71%. PETROBRAS PN caiu 1,03%, em mais um pregão de queda dos preços do petróleo no mercado internacional, onde o barril sob o contrato Brent fechou com declínio de 3,4%, a US$100,34, em meio a expectativa de avanços diplomáticos na crise com o Irã. No noticiário, a diretora de Engenharia, Tecnologia e Inovação da Petrobras, Renata Baruzzi, afirmou à Reuters que o petróleo descoberto no [USN:S0N4040AS TEXT:"poço de Morpho"], na bacia da Foz do Amazonas, é de "altíssima qualidade", talvez melhor que o do pré-sal. A campanha exploratória para poços adjacentes a Morpho deve começar no ano que vem. C&A ON (CEAB3.SA) avançou 6,6%, em pregão positivo para ações sensíveis a juros em meio ao alívio nas taxas dos DIs. O índice de consumo da B3 (.ICON) subiu 1,9%. BB SEGURIDADE ON (BBSE3.SA) caiu 2,55%. Analistas do Citi chamaram a atenção para dados da Susep mostrando que a companhia teve queda de 19% no lucro líquido em julho ante o mesmo período do ano passado, refletindo parcialmente resultados financeiros mais fracos da BrasilPrev, enquanto os prêmios no segmento rural caíram 40% ano a ano, sinalizando demanda mais fraca após o novo Plano Safra.

item.title: Poland concludes military air operations, says no airspace violation
item.description: Poland's army said on Friday it ended military aviation operations that had been launched earlier in the day in response to Russian strikes on Ukraine, with no violation of Polish airspace detected.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Poland's army said on Friday it ended military aviation operations that had been launched earlier in the day in response to Russian strikes on Ukraine, with no violation of Polish airspace detected. Ground-based air defence systems and radar reconnaissance units have returned to normal operations, the Polish Armed Forces Operational Command said in an X post.

item.title: Report: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) undergoes MRI
item.description: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels had an MRI on his dislocated left elbow and is not expected to play next week against the Seattle Seahawks, NFL Network reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels had an MRI on his dislocated left elbow and is not expected to play next week against the Seattle Seahawks, NFL Network reported Monday. Daniels dislocated his elbow on the final play of the first half in Washington's 37-20 road loss to the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday. As the Commanders attempted to score a touchdown rather than settle for a field goal, Daniels was stepped on by left guard Chris Paul and tripped trying to backpedal. He put his left (non-throwing) arm on the turf and his arm buckled under his body weight as he threw an incomplete pass. Washington coach Dan Quinn confirmed postgame that Daniels suffered a dislocation, the same injury he suffered to the same arm in a game against the Seahawks last season. The MRI will determine if there is any ligament damage. Daniels ended up missing seven of Washington's last eight games following his elbow injury last season. Marcus Mariota finished out Sunday's game at quarterback for Washington and went 11-of-16 for 111 yards and a touchdown. Mariota is expected to start next week's home opener against the defending Super Bowl champions. -Field Level Media

item.title: Aprovação de Trump cai para 32%, menor nível de sua carreira, diz pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos
item.description: O índice de aprovação do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, caiu para 32% -- o mais baixo de sua carreira política --, em meio a críticas de seus pares republicanos sobre sua maneira de lidar com o custo de vida e à impopular guerra contra o Irã, mostrou uma nova pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: O índice de aprovação do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, caiu para 32% -- o mais baixo de sua carreira política --, em meio a críticas de seus pares republicanos sobre sua maneira de lidar com o custo de vida e à impopular guerra contra o Irã, mostrou uma nova pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos. A pesquisa, concluída no domingo, foi realizada durante um período de quatro dias em que Trump expulsou três grandes veículos de comunicação da Casa Branca e sugeriu que o icônico Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts de Washington — batizado em homenagem ao presidente assassinado John F. Kennedy — poderia ser demolido caso o próprio nome de Trump não pudesse ser acrescentado a ele. A pesquisa revelou que os eleitores estão cada vez menos dispostos a apoiar os pares republicanos de Trump nas eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro, que determinarão o controle do Congresso pelos próximos dois anos. A aprovação geral de Trump caiu em relação aos 35% registrados na pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos da semana passada, com o apoio entre seus próprios republicanos caindo de 82% para 73%. Trump voltou à Casa Branca em janeiro de 2025 com a promessa de conter a inflação e pôr fim às guerras no exterior. Em uma pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos realizada poucas horas após sua posse, ele registrou um índice de aprovação de 47%. Apenas 17% dos entrevistados na nova pesquisa aprovaram sua gestão em relação ao custo de vida, principal questão que, segundo os norte-americanos, determinará seu voto nas eleições de novembro. IRÃ COBRA SEU PREÇO A insatisfação entre os republicanos com relação ao tema vem crescendo desde que Trump iniciou a guerra contra o Irã, em fevereiro, o que levou a um aumento acentuado nos preços da gasolina e do diesel. Agora, pela primeira vez, a parcela de republicanos que desaprovam a forma como Trump lida com o custo de vida supera a fatia dos que a aprovam -- 51% contra 44%. O índice de aprovação de Trump é mais baixo do que qualquer outro registrado para seu antecessor democrata, Joe Biden, cujo mandato também foi marcado por uma inflação galopante e que acabou desistindo da tentativa de reeleição depois que um fraco desempenho no debate aumentou as preocupações com sua idade. O ponto mais baixo de Biden foi de 35%, atingido no final de outubro de 2024. Apenas 34% dos entrevistados na pesquisa mais recente aprovam os ataques ao Irã. O conflito privou o mundo de uma parcela significativa do petróleo e do gás produzidos no Oriente Médio e ameaça alimentar uma inflação mais alta nos EUA e em outros lugares, à medida que as empresas repassam os custos mais elevados dos combustíveis aos consumidores. Trump afirmou inicialmente que o conflito duraria algumas semanas e que o Irã precisava ser bombardeado para impedir que desenvolvesse armas nucleares. Já em setembro, o líder republicano prometeu que a guerra terminaria “imediatamente após” a eleição. Mas o Irã não tem dado sinais de recuo e, nas últimas semanas, Teerã e seus aliados ameaçaram causar novas perturbações nos mercados de petróleo. Oitenta e dois por cento dos entrevistados na pesquisa — incluindo nove em cada dez democratas e três quartos dos republicanos — afirmaram que o conflito provavelmente se estenderia por um “período prolongado”. A pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos mostrou que os eleitores registrados que participaram da pesquisa escolheram os democratas em vez dos republicanos — 43% contra 35% — quando questionados sobre como votariam nas eleições de meio de mandato. A diferença de 8 pontos foi a maior vantagem dos democratas nas pesquisas Reuters/Ipsos deste ano. Para os republicanos, perder o controle de qualquer uma das Casas do Congresso poderia complicar a agenda de Trump nos últimos dois anos de seu mandato. Os resultados da pesquisa sobre as intenções de voto para o Congresso oferecem uma visão geral de qual partido os norte-americanos em todo o país querem ver no comando do Congresso, embora os resultados não capturem todas as nuances das disputas Estado a Estado e distrito a distrito que determinam o controle do Senado e da Câmara dos Deputados. Trump continua popular entre os republicanos na questão da imigração — com 79% de seu partido apoiando-o —, mas apenas 36% dos norte-americanos em geral apoiam sua abordagem ao assunto e 55% a desaprovam. Alguns aliados republicanos no Congresso têm alertado que sua campanha agressiva para deportar pessoas que estão ilegalmente no país corre o risco de afastar eleitores cujas famílias imigraram recentemente para os Estados Unidos, como alguns hispânicos. O levantamento mostrou que 35% dos entrevistados aprovam a abordagem de Trump no combate ao crime, em comparação com 50% que desaprovam. A pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos foi realizada online e reuniu 1.277 respostas de adultos norte-americanos em todo o país. Ela tem margem de erro de 3 pontos percentuais.

item.title: EU continues talks on renewal of Russia sanctions, diplomats say
item.description: European Union countries are continuing deliberations on a proposed deal what would lift sanctions on Russia-linked billionaires Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman but ensure thousands of other individuals and organisations remain sanctioned, diplomats said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: European Union countries are continuing deliberations on a [USN:L6N45D0NG TEXT:"proposed deal"] what would lift sanctions on Russia-linked billionaires Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman but ensure thousands of other individuals and organisations remain sanctioned, diplomats said on Monday. One EU diplomat, speaking on condition of anonymity, said ambassadors from the EU's 27 member countries would resume talks in Brussels with the aim of reaching an agreement on Tuesday morning.

item.title: Zelenskiy and US spy chief Ratcliffe meet in Ireland, sources say
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy met US CIA chief John Ratcliffe at Shannon Airport in Ireland, two people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Tom Balmforth, Jonathan Landay
item.content:encoded: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy met US CIA chief John Ratcliffe at Shannon Airport in Ireland, two people familiar with the matter said. The meeting took place on Monday, one of the sources said. The other source said the pair spoke informally while their planes were being refueled without specifying a date. Both sources, who requested anonymity to discuss sensitive matters, declined to disclose details of their conversation. The meeting happened as Zelenskiy was traveling to New York to take part in the annual gathering of world leaders at the United Nations. Ratcliffe was on his way back from meeting Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, one source said. Ratcliffe's meeting with Zelenskiy comes less than a month since the CIA chief traveled to Moscow to meet with Russia's top intelligence officials. Neither Ratcliffe nor the CIA have publicly disclosed what was discussed in Moscow. One of the sources, who confirmed the Zelenskiy meeting to Reuters, said Ratcliffe had been in Moscow to discuss Ukraine, but they declined to elaborate. The New York Times reported last month that Ratcliffe used his trip to share his bleak assessment of the state of the Russian war against Ukraine and to urge the Russians to cut a deal before their position weakens.

item.title: A timeline of Trump administration moves to weaken endangered species protections
item.description: US President Donald Trump has scaled back regulations meant to protect endangered wildlife as part of a broader push to reduce permitting obstacles for energy, mining, agriculture and other development.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump has scaled back regulations meant to protect endangered wildlife as part of a broader push to reduce permitting obstacles for energy, mining, agriculture and other development. The 50-year-old Endangered Species Act is credited with helping to save the bald eagle, the US national bird, along with the California condor and numerous other animals and plants from extinction. Here is a timeline of actions the administration has taken in Trump's second term: April 16, 2025 The administration [USN:L1N3QU0SE TEXT:"proposes"] rescinding the ESA's regulatory definition of "harm," arguing that habitat modification should not qualify as a prohibited "take" of a protected species. In the ESA, "take" is defined as "to harass, harm, pursue, hunt, shoot, wound, kill, trap, capture, or collect, or to attempt to engage in any such conduct." Environmental groups say the proposal could make it easier for developers to damage wildlife habitat. November 19, 2025 The Interior Department [USN:L1N3WV0TC TEXT:"proposes"] four rules to roll back former President Joe Biden's endangered species regulations. The proposals would make it easier to exclude areas from critical habitat designations by considering economic and national security impacts. March 31, 2026 The Endangered Species Committee unanimously [USN:L1N40I110 TEXT:"exempts"] Gulf of Mexico oil and gas operations from certain requirements of the Endangered Species Act, citing national security and domestic energy needs. It is the first ESA exemption approved in more than three decades. July 10, 2026 The administration [USN:L1N43C0OX TEXT:"finalizes"] a rule removing habitat destruction from the regulatory definition of "harm" under the ESA. The change allows habitat modification so long as protected animals are not directly injured or killed. Days later, environmental groups [USN:L6N43G1BL TEXT:"sue"] to block the rule. July 17, 2026 The administration finalizes additional ESA regulatory changes, ending automatic protections for newly listed threatened species and making it easier for regulators to consider economic and national security concerns when designating critical habitat. September 4, 2026 Trump signs an executive order directing the Interior Department to determine whether gray wolves and Mexican wolves qualify for delisting or downlisting under the ESA and, if so, begin that process. September 9, 2026 Twenty states and Washington, D.C., sue the administration, challenging the revised definition of "harm" and other ESA rule changes that they say unlawfully weaken protections for endangered and threatened species. September 14, 2026 An internal memorandum from US Fish and Wildlife Service Director Brian Nesvik instructs agency officials to adopt a narrower interpretation of the ESA's prohibition on "take" following repeal of the harm rule. The memo says a prohibited take occurs only when intentionally directed at a particular animal, potentially limiting enforcement. The Interior Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Trump administration proposes $5 billion to kickstart investment fund to rebuild Gulf energy sites, WSJ reports
item.description: The Trump administration has proposed investing $5 billion in a new fund that would help Middle East countries rebuild energy infrastructure battered in the Iran war and reduce their reliance on the Strait of Hormuz to transport oil and gas, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing U.S. and Middle Eastern officials and documents.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration has proposed investing $5 billion in a new fund that would help Middle East countries rebuild energy infrastructure battered in the Iran war and reduce their reliance on the Strait of Hormuz to transport oil and gas, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing U.S. and Middle Eastern officials and documents. Reuters could not immediately verify the report. (This story has been refiled to fix the spelling of 'Gulf' in the headline.)

item.title: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) out vs. Giants
item.description: Los Angeles Rams star wide receiver Puka Nacua will not play in Monday night's home opener against the New York Giants, with the team making him inactive for Monday Night Football.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Rams star wide receiver Puka Nacua will not play in Monday night's home opener against the New York Giants, with the team making him inactive for Monday Night Football. Nacua had not practiced since Friday with what is listed as a hip/groin injury. Rams head coach Sean McVay referenced a sore groin for Nacua coming out of practice on Thursday. Nacua reeled in five catches for 74 yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the San Francisco 49ers on Sept. 10 in Melbourne, Australia. The 25-year-old led the NFL with 129 receptions last season and racked up 1,715 receiving yards with 10 touchdowns in 16 games. Through his first three NFL seasons plus one game this year, Nacua has 318 catches for 4,265 yards and 19 TDs. The Rams will also be without wide receiver Jordan Whittington due to a quadriceps injury. Veteran Davante Adams is expected to lead the wide receiver unit for quarterback Matthew Stafford. The only other active receivers are Konata Mumpfield, Xavier Smith and Tutu Atwell. The Rams also rely heavily on their four tight ends, led by Colby Parkinson and Tyler Higbee. --Field Level Media

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（21日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
反発して取引を終えた。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は１．１８％高だった。中東を巡る懸案...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（21日） 4:19 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は１．１８％高だった。中東を巡る懸案の打開に向けた外交進展への期待が高まり、相場を押し上げた。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は１．４５％高。金融大手ＨＳＢＣは１．４％、バークレイズは１．９％、スタンダード・チャータードは１．７％いずれも上昇した。

航空宇宙・防衛株指数は２．８２％高。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは３．８％、防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズは１．２％それぞれ上昇した。

銅価格の上昇を受け、銅大手アントファガスタは３．２％、資源大手アングロ・アメリカンは２．９％いずれも値を上げた。

原油先物価格が下落し、航空大手ブリティッシュ・エアウェイズ（ＢＡ）の親会社ＩＡＧは３．１％上昇した。一方、石油・ガス株指数は１．８７％安。石油大手のＢＰは２．８％、シェルは１．４％それぞれ下落した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。銀行やハイテク株が買われた。原油先物価格が下落したことも相場の支えとなった。ドイツのＤＡＸ指数など主要地域指数の大半が上昇した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種銀行株指数は１．７１％高。フランスの銀行ソシエテ・ジェネラルは１．８％上昇した。イタリアのバンコＢＰＭは、イタリアの銀行大手ウニクレディトとフランスのクレディ・アグリコルが共同買収を検討していると伝わり、４．３％値上がりした。

テクノロジー株指数は１．７１％高。フランスの半導体材料大手ソイテックは９．８％、ドイツの半導体製造装置メーカー、アイクストロンは５．１％それぞれ値上がりした。

一方、石油・ガス株指数は０．７６％下落。

デンマークの製薬大手ノボノルディスクは７．７％安だった。

ドイツでは北東部の州議会選挙で、極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」が躍進した。週内には、米中首脳会談が予定されている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

原油価格の急落を受けて独１０年債利回りが低下した。ドイツ地方選で極右「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」と極左政党が議席を伸ばしたものの、市場の反応はおおむね限定的だった。

ドイツ北東部メクレンブルク・フォアポンメルン州で実施された州議会選挙は、メルツ首相率いる保守与党キリスト教民主同盟 （ＣＤＵ）が１９４９年以降最悪の敗北を喫した。メルツ氏は２０日の出口調査の結果公表後、「大惨事だ」と述べたが、首相として続投し、改革を推進していく意向を示した。

さらに、ベルリン州議会選では極左の左翼党（リンケ）が勝利した。

アナリストは、ＣＤＵの低迷を受けて連立政権内の摩擦が増大し、ドイツの財政・経済見通しが不透明になるとの懸念から、ＡｆＤの支持拡大は本来、独国債に売り圧力をかけ得る材料だったと指摘。しかし、市場関係者は依然として、現政権が政策課題を推進し続けると見込んでいる。

こうした中、原油価格は２１日、３．５％を超える下落となり、９月９日以来初めて１バレル＝１００ドルを割り込んだ。今週の国連総会でイラン戦争を巡る外交が進展するとの期待に加え、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃が続く中、サウジアラビアからの原油出荷が部分的に回復したとの報道が材料となった。

独１０年債利回りは７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し３．４５％。

フランス１０年債利回りは１２ｂｐ低下の４．４５％。イタリア１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ低下の４．３３％。  １８日にはそれぞれ、１２．５ｂｐ、１０ｂｐ上昇していた。

金融市場は、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の中銀預金金利が２０２７年２月までに３％、２７年終盤までに３．３６％に達するとの見方を織り込んでいる。
